==Description==
This template is designed to help users properly cite dating for material from the [[2016]] [[Star Wars: Doctor Aphra (2016)|''Star Wars: Doctor Aphra'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book series]], which ran until [[2019]]. It covers:
*All 40 issues of the series.
*All three Annual issues.
*The short story "[[Epilogue]]," released as part of the short story collection [[Empire Ascendant|''Empire Ascendent'' 1]].

==Usage==
*<code><nowiki>{{Aphra2016Date|issue}}</nowiki></code>, where the '''issue''' parameter is the issue number of the [[2016]] [[Star Wars: Doctor Aphra (2016)|''Star Wars: Doctor Aphra'']] series, in which the dated events take place. The issue parameter is required for the template to work.
*<code><nowiki>{{Aphra2016Date|issue|event}}</nowiki></code>, where the '''event''' parameter is specific event that is being dated by the date note. The event is part of the clause "'',including [event],''". The event parameter is optional.

==Examples==
===''Doctor Aphra'' 1-8===
<pre><nowiki>{{Aphra2016Date|1|the [[death]] of [[Soo-Tath]]}}</nowiki></pre>

Results in:

{{Aphra2016Date|1|the [[death]] of [[Soo-Tath]]}}

<pre><nowiki>{{Aphra2016Date|22|[[Chelli Lona Aphra|Chelli Aphra's]] interrogation by [[Bor Ifriem]]}}</nowiki></pre>

{{Aphra2016Date|22|[[Chelli Lona Aphra|Chelli Aphra's]] interrogation by [[Bor Ifriem]]}}

{{Aphra2016Date|32|the [[Infiltration of the Red Mist|heist]] on the ''[[Red Mist]]''}}
